story.titleZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛：赢家与输家
story.summaryZh: 受雨水影响的练习赛让拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛更看重车手能否在第三节练习赛迅速进入状态。法拉利双车止步第二节排位赛，勒克莱尔在7号弯失误，汉密尔顿从第三节练习赛起表现不佳。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying
story.summaryEn: Rain-affected practice sessions put extra emphasis on hitting the ground running in FP3 and carrying that form into Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying. Ferrari suffered a double Q2 exit, with Charles Leclerc making a mistake at Turn 7 and Lewis Hamilton struggling from FP3 onwards.
detailZh: 受雨水影响的F1练习赛意味着，人们更加看重在第三节练习赛（FP3）中迅速进入状态，并把这种状态延续到拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中。
谁在关键时刻顶住了，谁又没能兑现此前的势头？
对法拉利来说，这是跌宕起伏的一年，但在拉斯维加斯双车止步第二节排位赛（Q2）无疑是低谷之一——即便这条赛道的复杂特性让它有些特殊。
夏尔·勒克莱尔在7号弯出现失误，未能完成第二个计时圈；而刘易斯·汉密尔顿从第三节练习赛起就显得缺乏说服力。
勒克莱尔迅速指出，这个失误是“在大量挫败感之后发生的，随着我们在管理交通状况等方面犯下许多错误而不断累积”，并表示法拉利可能是第三次练习赛中出现的GPS问题的受害者。
他补充说，法拉利必须全神贯注于提升轮胎温度，因为这是车队的“弱点”。
汉密尔顿实事求是地谈到了他认为法拉利在哪里吃亏，他说：“在直道上损失很大一块。感觉我们没有很强的抓地力。我们一直很难让轮胎进入工作状态，我们就是有点找不到方向。”
这很好地总结了情况。
车队表示，他的最后一圈“非常非常好”，所以显然车队对汉密尔顿跑出的这一圈并不失望。
而汉密尔顿认为，在第一节排位赛中丢失一块底板部件，单是下压力就让他损失了“零点三到零点四秒”，同时他还声称，一个部署问题是他第二节排位赛最后一圈的重大阻碍。——杰克·贝尼恩
说到安东内利的第三节排位赛，很难不套用拉斯维加斯的赌博老梗。
他做出了冒险决定，在5号弯减速让行，掉到车阵末尾。要是他晚几秒到达起跑线，他甚至根本无法开始自己的飞驰圈。
相反，他刚好及时赶上，并发现自己处于完美的位置，在圈末借助多辆车的尾流直冲终点线，跑出最快圈速，巧妙地将他因更换引擎而受的五位发车格罚退的痛苦降到最低。
尽管或许有一点幸运，但这很好地体现了安东内利今年全程处理事情有多么出色。他游走在灾难的边缘，只为碾压所有人。
而且从发车格第六位起步，谁又敢赌他不会在正赛中迅速跻身维斯塔潘和拉塞尔之间呢？——乔什·萨蒂尔
安东内利的发车格罚退将把拉塞尔提升到发车格第二位，但考虑到拉塞尔在第三节练习中领先九成（0.9秒）的强势表现，排位赛会让人觉得错失良机。
事实上，拉塞尔在Q3的最终圈速比他在第三节练习中还要慢，他恳求的尾流最终也没有得到。
他在排位赛后的新闻发布会上圆滑地说“我们会私下沟通，可以再谈”，但对于自己的请求被拒绝，他显然感到沮丧。
尤其是因为这导致他被那位再次激怒他的车手击败，丢掉了（继承而来的）杆位。——JS
尽管报告他的红牛赛车存在“一些奇怪的问题”，维斯塔潘的表现仍足以让他成为未受罚车手中的最快者。
他不确定这些问题是否会在正赛距离中拖累他——就像在奥斯汀那样——但他已经做好了充分准备，争取在六场比赛中第四次获胜，并继续将自己确立为安东内利在2027年最大的威胁。- JS
皮埃尔·加斯利在Q2中引人注目的第二名是否让他梦想着再次挑战杆位，就像在蒙扎那样？
加斯利没有这么说，但接下来发生的事情无疑令人失望。即使期望挑战前列位置不现实，复制他Q2的圈速本可以让加斯利在Q3中排名第五，并且由于基米·安东内利的罚退，他在发车格上排名第四。
然而，准备圈没有按计划进行，带着冷胎进入第一个弯角，在第一赛段损失了“两到三个十分之一秒”，圈速就此告吹，让他落后于两位小红牛车手，仅领先于队友弗兰科·科拉平托——后者幸运地只是擦到墙壁，没有更严重的后果。
这种剧情转折恰好概括了 阿尔派 在下半赛季对小红牛的追赶。——杰克·科曾斯
阿尔维德·林德布拉德已经拿下本赛季个人最佳排位成绩，并将因安东内利的发车位罚退而进一步受益，从第五位起步。
林德布拉德今年跑出过许多非常强劲的排位圈——包括最近几场比赛，他说由于各种不同因素影响了他的成绩，这些圈速我们并未看到——但即便是他本人也不确定这一圈能否与自己的最佳表现相提并论。
“当时太混乱了，轮胎不工作，所以我出现了很多转向不足，我在8号弯犯了一点小错误，所以这不是完美的一圈，”林德布拉德在被 The Race 问及这一圈是否感觉像是他本赛季较为特别的一圈时解释道。
“但与此同时，最近几场比赛有很多事情没有按照我的意愿发展，那是我无法控制的。”
利亚姆·劳森将后退两个位置发车，因为小红牛这对组合再次在排位赛中击败了两名阿尔派车手，他们正在为车队积分榜第五名而战。劳森在Q2给了林德布拉德一个尾流，林德布拉德总结说：“我觉得其实并不完全需要，但很感激。”——JB
哈斯车队周五到来时希望让两辆车都进入Q2，并利用被罚退严重的奥利·贝尔曼为拉斐尔·卡马拉提供尾流，以获得更好的发车位。
但首次使用干胎（光头胎）跑圈意味着那些期望很快被重新调整。
贝尔曼表示：“不幸的是，我们的速度不够快。我们在第三节练习中已经证明了这一点。所以，是的，我没能完成一个计时圈，我只是在努力帮助拉法晋级。基本上，要让两辆车都进入第二节排位赛，那会太困难了。”
事实证明，要让哪怕一辆车进入第二节排位赛都太困难了——尽管贝尔曼做出了“惊人的表现”，这是排位第17名的卡马拉所说的，他表示对队友“不能要求更多了”。
再加上贝尔曼在第三节练习中于第一个弯道出现了一次诡异的打转——用他的话说，这与哈斯车队的“排位赛引擎映射以及后刹车基本上如何与MGU-K相互作用”有关——而卡马拉在第一节排位赛中实际上复制了同样的情况，这些加在一起，构成了哈斯车队一段时间以来在性能方面最艰难的一天。——JC
detailEn: The rain-affected Formula 1 practice sessions meant there was added emphasis on hitting the ground running in FP3 and carrying that through into Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying.
Who nailed it when it mattered most, and who failed to deliver on their earlier promise?
It's been a rollercoaster year for Ferrari, but a double-Q2 exit in Las Vegas has to be one of the lowest moments - even if the intricacies of this track make it a bit of an outlier.
Charles Leclerc made a mistake at Turn 7 and failed to get a second lap in, while Lewis Hamilton didn't look convincing from FP3 onwards.

Leclerc was quick to point out the mistake was "following a lot of frustration, building up with a lot of mistakes with the way we managed" traffic, among other things, and said Ferrari might have been a victim of a GPS issue that hit during FP3.
He added that Ferrari had to be fully focused on gaining tyre temperature because that is the team's "weakness".

Giving a matter-of-fact take on where he thought Ferrari was losing out, Hamilton said: "It's a big chunk on the straights. It didn't feel like we had a tonne of grip. We were struggling to get the tyres working and we were just kind of nowhere."
That sums it up well.
His last lap was "very, very good", according to the team, so clearly it wasn't upset with the lap Hamilton put together.

And Hamilton reckoned losing a piece of his floor in Q1 cost him "three or four tenths" in downforce alone, while he also claimed a deployment issue was a big hinderance on his final Q2 lap. - Jack Benyon
It’s difficult to resist the Vegas gambling cliches when it comes to Antonelli's Q3.
He made the risky decision to back off at Turn 5 and drop to the back of the pack. Had he arrived at the line a couple of seconds later, he wouldn't even have been able to start his lap.

Instead, he made it just in time and found himself in the perfect place to pick up a monster, multi-car tow to the line at the end of the lap, setting the fastest time and minimising the pain of his five-place engine grid penalty brilliantly.
Albeit perhaps a touch fortunate, it was a good example of how beautifully Antonelli has played things throughout this year. Walking right up to the edge of disaster in order to crush everyone.
And from sixth on the grid, who would bet against him quickly getting himself amongst Verstappen and Russell in the race? - Josh Suttill
Antonelli's grid penalty will bump Russell up to second on the starting grid, but qualifying will feel like a missed opportunity given how strong Russell was in FP3, which he topped by nine tenths.
In fact, Russell actually ended up slower in Q3 than he'd been in FP3, left without the tow he pleaded for.
He diplomatically said "we'll take it offline, and we can talk about it" in the post-qualifying press conference, but he was clearly frustrated to have had his request denied.
Not least because it led to him being beaten to (an inherited) pole by the driver who has yet again infuriated him. - JS
Despite reporting "some weird issues" with his Red Bull, Verstappen did enough to be the fastest of the unpenalised drivers.

He wasn't sure if those issues will hamper him over a race distance - as they did at Austin - but he is well poised to fight for a fourth victory in six races and continue to set himself up as Antonelli's biggest 2027 threat. - JS
Did Pierre Gasly's eye-catching second place in Q2 have him dreaming of another challenge for pole position, a la Monza?

Gasly didn't say as much, but what came next was undoubtedly a disappointment. Even if it was unrealistic to expect a challenge for the top positions, replicating his Q2 lap would've put Gasly fifth in Q3, and fourth on the grid with Kimi Antonelli's penalty.

Instead, the prep lap didn't go to plan and, with cold tyres into the first corner, "two, three tenths" were lost in the first sector and the lap was gone, leaving him behind both Racing Bulls drivers and ahead only of team-mate Franco Colapinto - who was lucky to escape brushing the wall without more severe consequences.
It's the sort of turn of events that sums up Alpine's pursuit of Racing Bulls in the second half of the season. - Jack Cozens
Arvid Lindblad already bagged his best qualifying of the year and will benefit further from Antonelli's grid penalty to start fifth.

Lindblad's put in plenty of very strong qualifying laps this year - including in the last few races, which, he says, we haven't seen due to different things impacting his results - but even he wasn't sure this would be up there with his best.

"It was such a mess, the tyres weren't working, so I had a lot of understeer, I made a bit of a mistake in Turn 8, so it wasn't a perfect lap," Lindblad explained when asked by The Race whether it felt like one of the more special laps of his season.
"But also at the same time, there's a lot that's not gone my way the recent races, that's been out of my control."

Liam Lawson will start two places further back, as the Racing Bulls duo again outqualified the two Alpine drivers they're fighting for fifth in the constructors' championship. Lawson gave Lindblad a tow in Q2 which "I don't think it was entirely needed, but grateful", Lindblad summarised. - JB
Haas came into Friday hoping to get both cars into Q2 and using the heavily penalised Ollie Bearman to tow Rafael Camara to a better grid position.
But its first taste of slick-tyre running meant those expectations were quickly readjusted.

"Unfortunately, we weren't quick enough. We showed that in FP3," said Bearman. "So, yeah, I didn't get to set a lap, I was just trying to help Rafa to come through. It would have been too difficult basically to get both cars into Q2."
It was too difficult, it turns out, to get even one car into Q2 - despite Bearman doing "an amazing job", per 17th-place qualifier Camara, who said he "couldn't ask for more" from his team-mate.

Throw in a weird Bearman spin at the first corner in FP3 - in his words, to do with Haas's "quali engine map and how the rear brakes basically interact with the MGU-K" - that was effectively replicated by Camara in Q1, and this added up to Haas's most difficult day, performance-wise, for some time. - JC
keyPointsZh: 法拉利双车在拉斯维加斯排位赛止步第二节排位赛，最终位列第11和第12位。
勒克莱尔在7号弯失误，未能完成第二个计时圈；他还提到车队可能受到第三节练习赛中出现的GPS问题影响。
汉密尔顿表示赛车在直道上损失明显，轮胎抓地力和升温都很困难，并认为第一节排位赛中底板部件脱落让他损失了零点三到零点四秒。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari had a double Q2 exit in Las Vegas qualifying, ending up 11th and 12th.
Leclerc made a mistake at Turn 7 and failed to complete a second lap; he also said the team may have been hit by a GPS issue during FP3.
Hamilton said the car lost a big chunk on the straights and struggled for grip and tyre temperature, and reckoned losing a piece of his floor in Q1 cost him three or four tenths.

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) 1m24.370s +0.096s (gap to Q2)

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
